description: For an app on the App Store. Needs App Store Connect with Analytics. Add a date called Released to the run's values, and each check comes to you on its day, from 1 to 28 days after, with a card; set one to wake you if the phone will be face down.
name: After a release

steps.description: Add a date called Released to this run's values. Nothing below starts until it has a day.
steps.title: Say the day it was released

steps.description: App Store Connect, Analytics. Write down the crash rate and the share of people who came back the next day. Retention can show a day or two late: if it is not there, say so in a note and look again on day 3.
steps.title: Day 1: crashes and day-one retention

steps.description: Read every new review. Reply in one line to the ones you can answer. Note any that say the same thing twice.
steps.title: Day 3: reviews, and a reply to each

steps.description: Fault, request, confusion, thanks. Count each pile in a note. Confusion is a sentence or a page that was unclear, and it is often the cheapest thing to fix.
steps.title: Day 7: sort the support mail into four piles

steps.description: Anything you changed because somebody wrote in gets one line, in the words of the person it helps. If nothing changed, say so in a note. Mail that changes nothing is worth a second look.
steps.title: Day 14: one line in the changelog for each change mail caused

steps.description: In App Store Connect, open Retention and split it by source: search, a campaign link, a web page. Write one sentence on which source keeps people. It counts only people who agreed to share, so it is a sample.
steps.title: Day 28: retention by source
